connects_to.relationship: multi-year Indium Phosphide epiwafer supply agreement

contracts.signal: Joint IQE / Tower release furnished on 6-K: a multi-year agreement for IQE to supply indium phosphide (InP) epiwafers for optical connectivity serving AI-driven data centre infrastructure; the epiwafers will be used in several of Tower's advanced silicon photonics platforms, and the collaboration covers technology for 200Gbs/lane pluggable transceivers, prototyping of next-generation 400Gb/lane modulators and optical circuit switches for data centres. Terms: a minimum purchase commitment by Tower in the first year, a reciprocal supply commitment from IQE and minimum volume commitments thereafter. Under a separate agreement Tower grants IQE a broad worldwide royalty-free licence to its porous silicon patents, settling all litigation between the companies. Tower President Marco Racanelli called IQE 'a key supplier for our next-generation photonic technologies'.
contracts.units: minimum first-year purchase commitment by Tower; minimum volume commitments thereafter
